claims.text: The four conversational QA models were selected based on their different architectures and training strategies: BERT, GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD.
BERT serves as a baseline model, while GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD incorporate advanced mechanisms to better handle conversational context.
GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD explicitly model question dependencies on conversation history, which improves their performance compared to BERT.
